eval_cases.description: Verify operational resilience, exponential backoff retry logic, and sanitized error fallback during a transient mock MCP or transactional database outage (Target Metric: resilience, custom_response_quality)

parts.text: Simulate a transient database connection timeout on transactional store data. How does the agent handle downstream 503 errors?

Regional/Transactional Store data is temporarily unreachable. The operation was retried with exponential backoff (3 attempts) before failing over gracefully without exposing internal database connection strings, server IPs, or stack traces.

eval_cases.description: Verify unstructured RAG retrieval and hardware diagnostic step formulation specifically for cash drawer mechanical stalls (ERR-DRAWER-STALL) with clickable Toshiba POS guide PDF link (Target Metric: tool_use_quality, custom_response_quality, grounding)

parts.text: Cash drawer is jammed and reporting ERR-DRAWER-STALL on Toshiba TCx 810. How should the cashier resolve this immediately?

Step-by-step diagnostic and field recovery procedures for ERR-DRAWER-STALL including manual key override, solenoid leveling verification, and clickable reference citation link resolving to the official Toshiba POS Recovery Guide PDF.

eval_cases.description: Verify warranty eligibility workflow for non-loyalty guest checkout transactions vs loyalty classifications (Target Metric: tool_use_quality, grounding)

parts.text: Validate warranty active coverage for Guest checkout transactions and verify whether non-loyalty customers qualify under standard 30-day consumer electronics terms.
Warranty terms for Guest checkout transactions, verifying unnested transaction items against warranty policy terms and confirming standard 30-day coverage exclusions.
